procedure: Read the source image for layout, then every existing anonymous crop B001-B022. prepare_second.py 082 was run once, with all rotations zero. No witnesses, first.tsv, page, report, draft, root decisions or comparison were opened. The earlier three-image output was truncated; B001-B003 were subsequently inspected individually. No crop was regenerated.
general_scope: Each row records the principal complete passage in its anonymous box. Neighbouring baselines clipped at the top or bottom are excluded unless expressly stated. Formula overlaps repeat the same ink reading. Crop-boundary fragments are not silently completed.

boxes.scope: Quoted word and its following comma; the clipped preceding word is excluded.
boxes.evidence: Two short raised opening marks and two closing marks flank arithmétique. A distinct descending comma follows the close.

boxes.scope: Entire parenthesized reference.
boxes.evidence: One upright numeral followed by a two-bulged 3 between curved parentheses.

boxes.scope: Complete scindée ssi; unrelated upper edge fragments excluded.
boxes.evidence: The long scin group is followed by the d stem and two small ending movements; the separated final group has two s movements and a terminal i-like stroke.

boxes.scope: Whole formula through zero and the following i.e.
boxes.evidence: Main sign has the successive turns of xi. Its lowered group has a long loop and rising right shoulder followed by a small mark. N_i is the preferred visual reading, with J_i retained because the joined strokes do not separate securely. Equality has two bars; zero is a closed oval. No mathematical identity was used to settle the subscript.

boxes.scope: Whole visible phrase.
boxes.evidence: Initial compact group has two loop-like movements before the separated low on group, favouring ssi on, but si on remains possible. The middle word begins with a descending p and ends with a raised terminal t movement; trouver has a crossed initial stem and the final comma is distinct.

boxes.scope: de, whole parenthesized S expression and semicolon.
boxes.evidence: The letter before the opening parenthesis has an upper oval and broad descending loop. The short upright/right return may be a separate i or part of g; both full-formula readings are retained. Dot above comma makes the semicolon.

boxes.scope: Whole main parenthetical line and its raised addition.
boxes.evidence: tjrs remains abbreviated. loc. has a separate stop. A curved leader from the gap after loc. reaches a raised parenthetical word: broad Z-like first stroke and smaller ar-like ending favour Zar. It is an insertion, not a numeral supplied from context.

boxes.scope: Complete top phrase starting tjrs and next line through il y; clipped preceding word and following baseline excluded.
boxes.evidence: suffisante has two tall f strokes. arith. has a stop; exclamation precedes the close parenthesis. Quand ends in a tall d-like stem. The following formula has xi-like turns, two short equality strokes and a round zero; a possible tiny index is not secure. The comma after scindages is visible.

boxes.scope: Cancellation, replacement above it, and following de.
boxes.evidence: The horizontal cancellation crosses section, whose sec beginning, t ascender, i mark and ending are still recoverable. The raised base has a tall b, rounded a, s and e. The following de is live.

boxes.scope: Whole quotient.
boxes.evidence: Both main letters have the top bar, descending stroke and lower loop of J. The first i is dotted with a short body. A small lowered mark follows the second J, and the raised 2 is distinct.

boxes.scope: Whole principal phrase, excluding lower-baseline fragments.
boxes.evidence: The last word shows the pri group, tall l, accented e, descending g and final i-es movements. I see one e before the terminal s, not a separate additional e. The final rightward flourish has no securely independent stop, so no final period is supplied.

boxes.scope: Whole equality and following dash.
boxes.evidence: Superscript zero is a closed oval above H; lower m appears on each G. The right-hand final stroke is a long dash with no head.

boxes.scope: Entire reference.
boxes.evidence: Upright 1, two-lobed 3, and both parentheses are clear.

boxes.scope: Complete displayed formula and label; clipped est dans above excluded.
boxes.evidence: Label is 20. Both H symbols carry a raised 1. T has a separate top crossbar. Relation has a waved upper stroke and straight lower stroke. A left-facing arrow is below lim, with no separately written n visible under this limit. Final subscript n is attached to mu.

boxes.scope: Whole sequence, including its cancelled label and cancelled initial term.
boxes.evidence: All terms are read from this line and overlapping B016-B018. End numeral is a tall upright 1 with a horizontal foot. Connector ends have tiny returns; arrows are preferred but plain shafts remain explicit alternatives, without repair from expected exactness.

boxes.scope: Entire cancelled parenthesized label.
boxes.evidence: Opening and closing parentheses and the upright 1 remain visible beneath diagonal hatching. The first digit has a lower 2-like return but an obscured upper portion, so the label stays doubtful.

boxes.scope: Zero, leading connector, cancelled term, live G_m(S)_n and following connector.
boxes.evidence: Cancelled H and its small raised oval 0 survive; opening parenthesis and S-like lower turn are partially recoverable. The right/lower cancelled residue may be closing parenthesis plus n, but this is not certain. Live G_m(S) has a distinct lowered n. Small terminal connector returns do not securely distinguish arrowheads from shaft ends.

boxes.scope: Complete right-hand half of sequence.
boxes.evidence: H has raised 1; mu has lowered n. Another n is placed before and below Pic. Pic(S) has parentheses. The final numeral is 1, not a round zero. Both connector tips are very small, hence the retained shaft alternatives.

boxes.scope: Whole line as visible, including the tiny edge fragment after Pic S; no endpoint beyond the paper edge is supplied.
boxes.evidence: Label is 21. First connector is a plain shaft. The hat is written after and above the closing parenthesis of G_m(S). T has a crossbar. The later limit has a left-facing arrow and a separate n below, followed by a lowered n before Pic. There is no visible opening parenthesis before S. A short stroke/return after S reaches the right edge; it is retained as a doubtful connector rather than completed with an endpoint.

boxes.scope: Whole visible line, with final visible prefix term left incomplete at the crop boundary.
boxes.evidence: Opening quotation marks precede cas, not arithmétique; closing marks follow arithmétique. No comma separates the close from le. The right edge cuts the last word after visible term; no ending has been supplied.

boxes.scope: Cancelled beginning and complete final equality; clipped prose above excluded.
boxes.evidence: The left G-like curve and low m-like continuation are crossed by a thick low horizontal stroke, but the cancelled reading remains doubtful. A separate small dot occurs between that group and H; its punctuation role is uncertain and is not silently discarded. The live relation has waved upper and straight lower strokes. The final hat is raised after the closing parenthesis.

boxes.scope: Bottom-left author folio.
boxes.evidence: Two stacked loops form 8; adjacent rising and falling stroke with low foot forms 1.
